narrative.details:
You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.

Perhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This barrel is largely untouched. Prying it open...

...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese. It's a little wet, but still tasty!

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 22 to 25, 5,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Claws from the Deep
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs. Slay Gobbler and take his head. Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Reclaiming Goods
quests.objectiveText: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.

quests.name: Search More Hovels
quests.objectiveText: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Return the Statuette
quests.objectiveText: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Return the Statuette
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

quests.name: A Friend of the Family
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: A Friend of the Family
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
